subject: Follow-up: estimate & next steps — quick 15m to walk through?
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 09:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Proposal and pricing deck from today's discovery

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the time earlier. I left the call with Ben and wanted to make sure you have the estimate and a short TCO one-pager attached. Quick summary below and a suggested next step so we can align on what best maps to OliveTech's latency and residency needs.

Highlights (from today's discovery)
- Primary goal: lower inference cost for your classification pipeline while keeping p95 latency < 200ms for 98% of requests.
- Data residency: EU + US options required; you mentioned SOC2 evidence as part of procurement.
- Expected Q1 ramp to ~5M tokens/day.

What's attached
- Redwood_Estimate_OliveTech_v1.pdf (pricing per-tier, reserved capacity options)
- Redwood_TCO_onepager.pdf (latency/cost tradeoffs, batching guidance)

Suggested next step
- 15-minute walkthrough where Ben can show how Dedicated capacity maps to your throughput profile and I can answer procurement/security questions.

Proposed slots (PST): Thu 11/16 10:00 or Fri 11/17 14:30 — if neither works, reply with 2 times that do.

If you'd like, I can also loop in our security lead (Markus Klein) if you want to run through SOC2/controls.

Thanks —

--
Soojin Lee
AE, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
[Attachment: Redwood_Estimate_OliveTech_v1.pdf (pdf, 1.2MB)]
[Attachment: Redwood_TCO_onepager.pdf (pdf, 320KB)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 08:32:00 -08:00
Subject: quick check — did the estimate land?

Hi Priya —

Wanted to quickly confirm the estimate and one-pager landed in your inbox. I know teams get pulled into other priorities this time of year — if this is still on your radar, would love to lock a 15-minute slot to walk through the reserved capacity options and latency expectations.

Two short options I have this week (PST): Tue 11/21 09:00 or Tue 11/21 11:00. Calendly link if easier: https://calendly.com/soojin-lee/15min

If you'd prefer, I can also send a short comparison table that maps your expected token distribution to cost-per-1M tokens across hosted vs dedicated profiles.

Thanks for the nudge either way —

Soojin

From: Priya Reddy <priya@olivetech.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: quick check — did the estimate land?

Thanks Soojin —

Yes, I got the PDF and skimmed the TCO one-pager. A couple quick clarifications before we lock time:
- For Dedicated, which SKU maps to a target p95 ~150ms for short classification requests? Your table has "Reserved Large" and "Reserved XL" — curious which you expect will meet the latency target at our 5M tokens/day profile.
- Procurement wants a one-line confirmation on data residency options and whether logs/audit exports are retained per-customer (we need them stored in our EU region).

We can do a short call — Tue 11/21 13:30 ET (that should map to 10:30 PT) works on my side. Please include Ben and anyone from security who can confirm the SOC2 evidence and log retention.

—Priya
Procurement, OliveTech
[Procurement attachment: PO_Request_Form.xlsx (xlsx, 26KB)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Priya Reddy <priya@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Nov 2028 14:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: quick check — did the estimate land?

Perfect — thanks for the questions and for the slot. 10:30 PT / 13:30 ET is now on my calendar. I’ll loop in Markus (security) to confirm SOC2 and EU log retention during the call; Ben will walk through SKU mapping so we can agree on the right reserved profile.

Quick answers in the meantime:
- Reserved XL is the SKU we generally recommend for p95 ~150ms at the 5M tokens/day profile; Ben will show sample traces.
- Yes — we support region-specific log export and retention per-customer. Our default retention is 30 days, but we can provide longer retention via an enterprise add-on and export logs to an EU S3 bucket under your KMS.

I'll send a calendar invite to confirm and attach the short comparison table we discussed. Looking forward to the call.

Best —

Soojin Lee
AE, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
